caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a standing woman rendered in shades of gold and brown, with some subtle blue-gray highlights, holding a tall flagpole in her left hand. The flagpole is topped with an American flag that has alternating gold and brownish stripes and a blue field with white stars, with the flag appearing to wave to the left. The woman's right arm is extended straight out to her right side, her head is turned slightly in that direction, and she is dressed in a long, textured gown with visible folds and shading. The composition is centered on a plain, light beige background, and the entire subject appears to be an ornamental silhouette or possibly a weathervane design, standing on a short, horizontal base. No additional objects or scenery are present in the drawing.
title: Gilt Weather Vane
